site.title.text: INHERITFI: choose who inherits your crypto

site.description.text: An inheritance protocol on Ethereum. Name heirs and recovery contacts for each asset. If you stop being active, they can claim it under rules written in the contracts.

menu.appDesc.text: Wrap assets and set up your plan

hero.lead.text: The first trustless on-chain inheritance protocol. Wrap your assets into inheritable tokens with programmatic succession, recovery mechanisms, and cryptographic distribution to your heirs. Now supporting {count} assets.

features.sub.text: Built for permanence. Designed for clarity.

features.onChainBody.text: No oracles. No multisig. No trusted parties. Pure smart-contract logic executes your wishes exactly as programmed, immutable, censorship-resistant.

features.heirsBody.text: Up to {max} heirs with custom percentage splits, configurable at any time.

features.recoveryBody.text: Heir inheritance + independent recovery-contact mechanism for key loss scenarios.

features.feesBody.text: Every protocol fee is hard-capped at {max} by the contracts. Sending iTokens is free.

features.assetsBody.text: ETH plus {erc20} leading ERC-20s, each in its own contract with its own balances and plans.

how.sub.text: Four steps to secure your digital estate.

how.wrapBody.text: Deposit any of {count} supported assets. Receive its inheritable iToken, 1:1 backed by contract.

how.configureBody.text: Set heirs with % splits and trusted recovery contacts on-chain.

how.liveBody.text: Any wrap, unwrap, transfer or plan update proves you're active, or confirm with one click. Your assets stay fully yours.

how.inheritBody.text: After the inactivity window, heirs execute distribution, completely trustless.

cta.body.text: Wrap your assets, set your heirs, and let the protocol handle the rest: automatically, trustlessly, forever.

footer.tag.text: Built for the future of on-chain succession.

notFound.body.text: This page doesn't exist. Check the address, or go to the home page.
